note: Values are copied from the personal dashboard source. They are illustrative study plots, not clinical records.

files.height-shoe-size.json: Scatter of height (cm) vs shoe length (cm) for girls and boys.
files.age-foot-length.json: Mean foot length (cm) by age 6-14, plus girl-minus-boy difference.
files.bmi-foot-ratio.json: Displayed foot plumpness index by BMI 12-24, plus the two ring-chart shares.
files.foot-symmetry-by-age.json: Generated with the same log formulas as the dashboard timeline pie.
files.plantar-pressure.json: Seven-site pressure sketch from draw1.js (not mounted on the live dashboard).
files.plantar-thickness.json: Fourteen-site plantar thickness sketch from draw2.js (not mounted on the live dashboard).
